verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a meeting-transcription SaaS can offer a no-training guarantee or opt-out. The pack has no documented control or commitment that keeps user data out of AI model training. The only related item is a 0-day data retention policy with vendors and partners (plus Private Storage). That is an adjacent retention and storage control, not a stated no-training guarantee or opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Private Storage options, 0-day data retention policy with all vendors and partners.
